changelog: **Affiliate import file pickers (#3175):** the three bare `<input type="file">` on `/admin/affiliates/migration` are now the shared `FileField` (`src/components/ui/FileField.tsx`): the real input stays focusable but visually hidden, an outline-button label says "Choose file" in the app's language (`affiliateMigration.chooseFile` / `noFileChosen`, EN/TR/DE), the chosen file's name (or "No file chosen") is the input's description, and the focus ring is drawn on the button. A file refused as non-UTF-8 reads as none. `e2e/affiliate-migration.spec.ts` asserts the labels and the file name.

en: Affiliate import: the file pickers now speak the app's language and match light and dark mode.
tr: Affiliate içe aktarma: dosya seçiciler artık uygulamanın dilinde ve açık/koyu temaya uyumlu.
de: Affiliate-Import: Die Dateiauswahl spricht jetzt die Sprache der App und passt zum hellen und dunklen Design.
